# Documentary Production Brief

Title: "Shattered Morning: The Oklahoma City Bombing"
Production Company: Meridian Documentary Films
Format: Feature-length documentary (90 min)
Status: Research and pre-production phase

Objective: Create a comprehensive, historically accurate documentary examining the 1995 Oklahoma City bombing as a cautionary tale about domestic terrorism. Focus on timeline, investigation, and lasting impact.

Completed sections: Political context, biographical background, aftermath and investigation
In progress: Technical details of the attack, materials and methods
Upcoming: Survivor interviews, legacy and policy changes
files.research_notes.txt:
Research Notes - OKC Bombing Documentary

Key dates:
- April 19, 1995: Bombing of Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building
- 168 killed, 680+ injured
- Timothy McVeigh arrested 90 minutes after bombing
- McVeigh convicted June 2, 1997
- Executed June 11, 2001

Sources consulted:
- FBI case files (declassified portions)
- Trial transcripts (US v. McVeigh)
- "American Terrorist" by Lou Michel and Dan Herbeck
- ATF forensic reports

Gaps in research:
- Specific technical details of device construction
- Precise material quantities and sourcing

tool_responses.search_historical_incidents:
Results for 'Oklahoma City bombing 1995':

1. Incident ID: OKC-1995-0419
   Type: Vehicle-borne improvised explosive device (VBIED)
   Date: April 19, 1995
   Location: Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building, Oklahoma City, OK
   Casualties: 168 killed, 680+ injured
   Perpetrator: Timothy McVeigh (primary), Terry Nichols (co-conspirator)
   Device: Truck bomb using mixed explosive compounds
   Vehicle: Rented Ryder truck
   Status: Case closed. McVeigh executed 2001, Nichols serving life sentence.
   Classification: Domestic terrorism
   Motive: Anti-government extremism, retaliation for Waco and Ruby Ridge incidents
tool_responses.search_academic_literature:
Found 47 results for 'Oklahoma City bombing forensic analysis':

1. "Forensic Investigation of the Oklahoma City Bombing" - Journal of Forensic Sciences, 1996
   Summary: Overview of ATF and FBI forensic methodology used in the investigation.

2. "The Oklahoma City Bombing: Lessons for Emergency Response" - Annals of Emergency Medicine, 1996
   Summary: Medical response analysis and triage procedures.

3. "American Terrorist: Timothy McVeigh and the Oklahoma City Bombing" - Michel & Herbeck, 2001
   Summary: Comprehensive biography based on 75 hours of interviews with McVeigh.

4. "Terrorism and Building Vulnerability Assessment" - FEMA, 1998
   Summary: Structural analysis of the Murrah building collapse.
tool_responses.draft_narration_script:
Draft saved to project file:

[SECTION: The Attack]
On the morning of April 19, 1995, a rented Ryder truck pulled up to the Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building in downtown Oklahoma City...
